summary: Hazardous-material categories for truck routing restrictions. mode=truck only.
range: Array enum: explosives | gas | flammable_liquid | flammable_gas | organic | toxic | radioactive | corrosive | other. Requires mode=truck.
businessRules: hazmat_type defines: Specify the type of hazardous material being carried and the service will avoid roads which are not suitable for the type of goods specified. Provide multiple values separated by a comma , . Please…
Each element in hazmat_type must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Valid options: explosives, gas, flammable_liquid, flammable_gas, organic, .... Each affects solver behavior differently.
Must stay consistent with: options.routing.mode. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: ["flammable_liquid"] with mode=truck routes around restrictions.
